evals.name: write-from-nothing
evals.prompt: This repository has no README. Write one. The repository is at REPO/ch-display-noreadme; work on that copy, read what you need, and write README.md there. Also copy the finished README.md to the output directory.
evals.expected_output: A README.md under 150 lines with a one-liner, what it does, why it exists, status, install, a first run with output, caveats, links into docs/, where to ask, and the MIT license; passes readme-check.
assertions: readme-check exits 0 on the written README.md in the repository copy
README.md is 150 lines or fewer
A why paragraph states the problem or the alternative (not only what it does)
A status line says stable, experimental, maintained, or deprecated, or marks the status as unknown for the creator to fill
The usage example shows a command and what it prints
The README links at least one file under docs/
No section describes architecture, internals, or development process
The one-liner under the title is under 120 characters and names what it does for the reader
The description names the bridge and the display as separate parts and says the bridge can run alone for other software

evals.name: rewrite-thin-readme
evals.prompt: The README in REPO/neckbeard is 19 lines and tells a new user almost nothing. Rewrite it for someone deciding whether to use this agent. Work on that copy, write README.md there, and copy the finished README.md to the output directory.
evals.expected_output: A rewritten README.md that keeps the facts of the old one, adds why, status, install, first run, caveats, docs links, support, and license, and passes readme-check.
assertions: readme-check exits 0 on the written README.md in the repository copy
Every fact from the old README survives: Ansible, approval before change, macOS/Linux/QNAP, questlog, memory
A why paragraph and a status line are present
Install and usage sections each have a code block
README.md is 150 lines or fewer
No fact is invented: every claim about the agent traces to a file in the repository or is marked as a question for the creator
No host inventory, page or quest counts, portrait, or history section beyond one status line
